name: PleIAs/YouTube-Commons
notes: Best launch and backfill source. Preserve video, channel, date, and license attribution.

name: ESPnet/YODAS
notes: Contains timestamped YouTube audio utterances and manual/automatic captions. Reconstruct only when source identity and attribution remain available.

name: HowTo100M
scale: 1.22 million narrated instructional videos; 136 million clips
license: Research dataset; no blanket public transcript-republication grant
notes: Excellent instructional topic coverage, but use IDs/queries for discovery and re-check each source license before publication.

name: YouTube-8M
scale: Millions of videos and thousands of machine-generated labels
notes: Useful for broad category vocabulary, but IDs are anonymized in downloadable feature files and it does not provide transcripts.

name: ActivityNet Captions
scale: About 20,000 YouTube videos and 100,000 temporal descriptions
license: Annotations and source videos have separate terms
notes: Descriptions are annotations, not verbatim transcripts. Re-check source availability and license.

name: YouCook2
license: Annotations only; source videos are not redistributed
notes: Useful cooking taxonomy and temporal procedure annotations, not a full transcript corpus.

name: Kinetics-700
scale: At least 700 clips for each of 700 human-action classes
license: IDs/annotations; source media remains on YouTube
notes: Useful action vocabulary, but ten-second clips generally do not provide research-grade spoken transcripts.
